lesson.title: Safety functions and non-safety functions
lesson.summary: Distinguish genuine non-safety functions from functions whose failure endangers safety.

prerequisites.reason: A safety function must be linked to the system's intended purpose.

blocks: A **safety component** fulfils a product or system safety function, or its failure or malfunction endangers health and safety of people or property. A safety function aims to prevent or mitigate those risks.

Northbridge's fictional protective device uses AI to preserve warning sounds while limiting harmful noise. If protection depends on the AI's correct operation, that is a safety-function fact to investigate.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 3(14), Article 6(1a) and (1b)

blocks: Article 6(1a) excludes systems solely used for non-safety aspects of assistance, optimisation, efficiency, automation, convenience or quality control from being safety components.

The word **solely** matters. A convenience interface that changes a safety-critical action is different from a convenience function isolated from all safety effects. The category name 'optimisation' cannot prove exclusivity.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 3(14), Article 6(1a) and (1b)

blocks: Article 6(1b) qualifies that limit: if failure or malfunction would endanger health and safety, the system qualifies as a safety component notwithstanding paragraph 1a.

Compare an AI choosing a harmless display colour with an AI wrongly suppressing a safety warning. The failure consequence changes the analysis. Obtain design and failure evidence rather than trusting the feature's marketing category.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 3(14), Article 6(1a) and (1b)

blocks: Record the function, affected safety mechanism, failure modes and consequences. In our invented device case, assume failure removes required hearing protection: the non-safety exclusion is not established.
This finds a safety-component fact only. Annex I coverage and the required third-party assessment still need separate evidence before the full Article 6(1) conclusion.

questions.prompt: AI controls a protective function preventing harmful exposure. Which fact is most relevant?

options.blocks: Its purpose prevents or mitigates safety risks
options.reason: Article 3(14) connects the function to health and safety protection.

options.blocks: Its interface uses a green icon
options.reason: Interface colour does not establish a safety function.
Price does not establish safety effects.

options.blocks: Whether the vendor chose that label
options.reason: A label is not evidence of the actual function.

options.blocks: Whether it is used by any employee
options.reason: The user's identity does not establish the exclusion.

options.blocks: Whether its use is exclusively non-safety-related
options.reason: The statute requires solely non-safety aspects.
